# Lehman Plant Care Co

> Lehman Plant Care Co (The Tree Service Clearence) is a professional tree
> care company serving residential and commercial properties, offering tree
> trimming, pruning, removal, and emergency storm cleanup.

Lehman Plant Care Co provides expert arboriculture services delivered with
precision, safety, and respect for the environment. The site below covers
our services, past projects, and how to reach us for a free quote.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lehman-plant-care-co.vercel.app/): Overview of Lehman Plant Care Co and our tree care services.
- [About](https://lehman-plant-care-co.vercel.app/about): Background on our team and approach to tree care.
- [Services](https://lehman-plant-care-co.vercel.app/services): Full list of tree services we offer, including trimming, pruning, removal, and storm cleanup.
- [Projects](https://lehman-plant-care-co.vercel.app/projects): Examples of completed tree care projects.
- [Contact](https://lehman-plant-care-co.vercel.app/contact): Request a free quote or get in touch with our team.
